column1: # Groups of similar methods where one is unambiguously the canonical
# implementation, against a discourse checkout.
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Every verdict was verified
# by reading both bodies and file history (`git log --diff-filter=A`), never
# assumed. Veto or amend any line.
# Format: canonical<TAB>alternate<TAB>evidence[<TAB>provisional]
# Evidence vocabulary as in the rails set: older, delegates, mirrors,
# ex_subclass.
# A caveat this corpus adds: several plugins (discourse-ai, discourse-post-
# voting) were developed outside this repo and merged in wholesale, so in-repo
# git evidence starts at the merge date. The labels below only assert edges
# where the copy direction is also visible in the code itself.
# vbulletin.rb (2014) is the source; modx.rb (2017) copied it and disabled the
# copies with a `not_` prefix — a dead mirror of the original.
ImportScripts::VBulletin#close_topics
ImportScripts::VBulletin#import_private_messages
# ning.rb (2015-01) had repair_json first; muut.rb (2015-06) copied it.
ImportScripts::Ning#repair_json
# chat's guardian extension (in-repo 2023) is what the post-voting plugin
# (merged 2025) copied, unused parameter and all.
Chat::GuardianExtensions#can_flag_message_as?
# discourse-ai's reviewable copied chat's; chat's has since gained the
# combined-actions rename and one icon fix the copy lacks. Provisional because
# the plugin's pre-merge history is invisible in this repo.
Chat::ReviewableMessage#build_combined_actions
# The cleanest provenance in the corpus: a8560d741f0 (2020) is literally
# "DEV: Create ExportUserArchive as clone of ExportCsvFile"; get_header dates
# to fadddccf8ab (2014) in the original.
Jobs::ExportCsvFile#get_header
# UpdateUsername's post rewriter (3be3c50c7e0, 2018) is what ChangeDisplayName
# copied when display-name renames were added (a183f14d093, 2023).
Jobs::UpdateUsername#update_post
# BulkDestroy (118f7869bb4, 2024) is what BulkSuspend copied when bulk
# suspension was added (a1ebd19813d, 2026).
User::BulkDestroy#fetch_users
